prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for an original dark fantasy RPG. Reference image is character design reference. Preserve skeletal crowned executioner, bronze-black heavy armor with skull shoulder and spikes, long torn deep-purple cape and tabard, huge two-handed black greatsword with red edge and skull guard. True transparent RGBA background, no backdrop or ground, no text, no grid lines, no shadows. EXACTLY 12 separate full-body poses in uniform 4 columns x 3 rows with generous transparent gutters, every limb sword and effect INSIDE its own cell. Consistent body scale, orthographic slightly overhead pixel-art game illustration. All 12 figures face DOWN toward viewer, FRONT view.. Row1 four consecutive walking poses with alternating legs and cape sway, sword carried. Row2 four distinct two-handed greatsword attack poses: wind-up sword raised, swing across, full strike with compact red-black crescent trail, recovery. Row3 first two poses casting: gather small red flame then release red rune; last two poses hit: flinch then recover. Weapon must remain recognizable sword NOT scythe; compact blade trails, no giant background aura. Entire crown, cape and weapon fit with margin. Landscape sheet.
